# AuditIQ — AI GST Compliance Audit Assistant

AuditIQ is an AI-powered GST compliance audit tool that validates transactions, detects duplicate invoices, checks GST rates, and generates compliance reports instantly.

## Core Features
- Drag-and-drop CSV/XLSX upload.
- Rule-based GST validation (GSTIN, Rates, Calculations, Duplicates).
- AI compliance narrative powered by Google Gemini.
- Real-time compliance dashboard.

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend: Supabase Edge Functions (Deno).
- AI: Google Gemini API.

## File Structure
- /src/App.tsx: Main application logic and UI.
- /supabase/functions/audit-compliance/index.ts: Edge function for audit processing.
- /README.md: Setup and usage guide.
- /LICENSE: MIT License.
